snippet.title: Bills Must Be Paid - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Bills Must Be Paid is out now! With a 30% Discount for only $4.89 (with regional adjustment) 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4421010/

You're broke, smashing piggy banks, Bills Must Be Paid.
Bills Must Be Paid is a short active incremental game where you smash piggy banks to pay your bills. Collect coins, upgrade, and get debt free!
